season.evidence: Route page: south-facing climbing at this coulee is possible nearly all year, the tower is a cool-season choice; Peakbagger summits cluster Mar-Apr and Oct-Nov. Summer is hot.

track.why: 16 Apr 2022, summited, logged route 'East Gully', report describes the class 3 gully to the notch and both summits; track's high point is about 15 m from the peak coordinate and start/end sit 8 m apart. Only scramble stored on the peak. No trailhead pin on our route, so none is proposed.

otherTracksConsidered.why: 25 Jul, South gulley (a different gully), outside the cool season.

facts.text: From the notch both summit blocks are third class; the left one is slightly easier and no rope is needed.

notes: A trailhead could not be confirmed from a fetched page (Mountain Project lists the tower at 47.0247,-119.9689 and only mentions a climbers' parking lot), so no pin proposed. Mountain Project flagged an access problem with the main road in May 2026.
